description: Swedish company register record by 10-digit organisation number (organisationsnummer) from Bolagsverket's and SCB's free weekly bulk files (EU high-value datasets): registered names, legal form, registration date, deregistration date and reason, ongoing liquidation or bankruptcy, business description, postal address, SNI industry codes and SCB status. About 2.2 million companies and associations; sole traders are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: b2b_iceland_skatturinn_companies when you need Icelandic company register: search companies by name; b2b_nz_companies_register when you need New Zealand Companies Register search: company name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: b2b_bolagsverket_sweden_companies
title: Swedish company register record by 10-digit organisation
